findings.title: Predicting Stock Price Direction on Earnings Announcement Days using Multi-modal Deep Learning
findings.summary: FinBERT sentiment + firm fundamentals + technical indicators fused in multi-modal DL model for PEAD directional prediction on announcement days.

findings.title: Extracting the Structure of Press Releases for Predicting Earnings Announcement Returns
findings.summary: Press release text as informative as EPS surprise for predicting announcement-day returns; 138K+ releases 2005-2023. Structural NLP features (tone, guidance language) add predictive power.

findings.title: Trading Graph Neural Network
findings.summary: TGNN for modeling asset/dealer/relationship features for price impact; novel pairs selection beyond cointegration.
findings.reason_not_staged: Pairs trading family exhausted in our pipeline (H152-H160, H200 all NOT CONFIRMED). GNN pairs would be a new attempt but prior consistent failures suggest the signal is weak for large-cap US equities at monthly frequency.

findings.title: Not All Factors Crowd Equally: Modeling, Measuring, and Trading on Alpha Decay
findings.summary: Hyperbolic decay model for factor alpha; momentum crowding measurable via ETF AUM growth.
findings.reason_not_staged: Already in wiki (factor-models.md, section 'Factor Crowding Risk'). No new staging needed.

findings.title: Building Cross-Sectional Systematic Strategies By Learning to Rank
findings.summary: Learning-to-rank ML for cross-sectional factor construction; reduces crowding effects.
findings.reason_not_staged: H241 showed XGBoost rank-target (effectively a ranking approach) gave only +0.054 Sharpe lift over simple ranking. Learning-to-rank unlikely to break through this ceiling without more informative features.

findings.title: Follow the Leader: Enhancing Systematic Trend-Following Using Network Momentum
findings.summary: Network momentum (leader/follower relationships between assets) combined with trend following.
findings.reason_not_staged: Targets time-series trend following (ETF rotation) rather than cross-sectional stock picking. Marginal relevance for current research direction.

findings.title: TradingAgents v0.2.4 — Multi-agent LLM trading framework
findings.summary: LangGraph-based 5-layer multi-agent framework; latest release adds checkpointing, structured outputs, 10 LLM provider support.
findings.reason_not_staged: Already noted in wiki (ml-for-trading.md). Update not needed — the framework is exploratory, not directly actionable for near-term hypothesis testing.

findings.title: Toward Expert Investment Teams: A Multi-Agent LLM System with Fine-Grained Trading Tasks
findings.summary: Multi-agent LLM system with task specialization (macro, technical, risk management) for portfolio construction.
findings.reason_not_staged: Already in wiki. Not directly actionable for specific hypothesis.

findings.title: FactorLab — Alpha and Risk Factor Discovery Library
findings.summary: Python library for factor discovery and IC analysis; useful for cross-sectional factor validation.
findings.reason_not_staged: Useful tooling but we already use alphalens-reloaded for factor analysis. Not worth adding another dependency at this stage.

wiki_expansion.motivation: H241/H242 established genuine stock-selection alpha in 200-stock universe; L/S construction needed to unlock it
